entry.title: 0.75.0 — Search right from the sidebar address, encrypted iCloud sync and a cleaner way to clear site data.
entry.summary:
Search right from the sidebar address, encrypted iCloud sync and a cleaner way to clear site data.
7 new · 8 faster · 14 fixed · 1 smaller
## New
- Clicking the address in the sidebar opens a compact command bar right over it, with the current address selected. Type a search or a new address and press Return to load it in the same tab, or press Tab to search the suggested site. - When Circa starts and the restored window has no open tab, the New Tab search opens right away, focused and ready to type. Press Escape to keep the empty page. - **Sync passwords** is a separate switch under Settings › General. It is off on new setups and stays on if you already synced; turning it off stops password sync on this Mac and leaves the copies already in iCloud. - **Clear Site Data for This Profile…** removes cookies, cache, local storage, IndexedDB and service workers for that profile only; history, passwords and site permissions stay. Clearing one site's data also works when no tab shows that site. - Private windows are hidden from window captures by other apps. - Every profile now sends Global Privacy Control, asking sites not to sell or share your data. - The app icon you choose in Settings › Appearance stays in the Dock when Circa is not running, as long as Circa is kept in the Dock.
## Faster
- Library history search no longer blocks visit recording or sync: searching 200,000 visits for a common word takes 18.5 ms → 1.8 ms, and for a site name 62 ms → 0.8 ms. - History sync writes only what changed: about 33 KB per sync instead of rewriting about 160 MB for a 200,000-visit history (disk write per cycle 2.7 s → 2 ms). - Retyping a letter you just deleted shows search suggestions in 275–306 ms → 2–4 ms. - While the assistant writes, each new word costs 24 ms → 1.0 ms of main-thread time on a 30-message conversation (peaks 52–134 ms → 1.2 ms). - Opening the assistant panel on a 120 Hz display draws 20 → 47 frames, with no frozen frames. - Toggling a site permission costs 9.1 ms → 0.007 ms on the main thread. - Refreshing 100 sidebar rows without a cached icon takes 3 ms → 0.1 ms. - Session saves during sustained activity: 6.3 → 1.1 per second.
## Fixed
- With nothing typed, the command bar lists your open tabs and favorites first, followed by the keyboard shortcuts help; searching for exactly what you typed comes right after the top suggestion. - Spaces, tabs, settings and history now sync end-to-end encrypted in iCloud, like passwords already did. - Deleting a password no longer leaves its secret in the sync record that tells other Macs to delete it. - Turning iCloud sync off deletes its local caches. - Deleting history for a time range, a site or a single visit also removes it from the engine's own history. - Links opened with ⌘-click, ⌥-click into a split, ⇧-click into Peek, or Open Link in New Tab / Split View keep their originating page, so sites no longer receive their strict same-site cookies on cross-site opens. - Tabs opened in the background with ⌘-click no longer appear blank when you select them. - Browser-internal debug pages and `javascript:` addresses can no longer be loaded from session restore, AppleScript, link routing or other apps, and AppleScript can no longer run JavaScript in a private window. - Link routing rules match only a link's site and path; links opened from other apps have embedded user names and passwords removed. - Link previews refuse local-network and private addresses, including after redirects; update checks no longer send cookies. - Removing a profile also deletes its web cache and cookie backups, and resumes that cleanup after an interruption. Clearing one site's data also removes its cookies from migration backups. - Circa no longer writes inside its own app bundle, so its code signature stays valid; macOS no longer keeps its own snapshots of browser windows. - The Safe Browsing key no longer stays in the environment of processes Circa starts later, and password exports read during an import stay in memory. - Assistant animations, the Today sidebar accessory and palette transitions follow the display's refresh rate; Space switches no longer write settings during the swipe.
## Smaller
- Refreshed the bundled ad and tracker blocking lists.
## Known limits
- An older Circa cannot read the newly encrypted sync records until it updates; going back manually to 0.74.0 leaves history unavailable (not deleted) until the next update. - Command-L still opens the centered command bar, and the compact bar over the address appears without an animation. - Finder keeps showing the default app icon; the Dock may only pick up the chosen icon after the next login. - The engine deletes a URL's visits for a whole day, so deleting one visit can remove other visits of that URL the same day from the engine's history; history deletions received from another Mac are not yet removed from it.
Engine / bundled components: Chromium 158.0.8127.37; maintained engine r24; EasyList / EasyPrivacy pin fd7771846bc3bed3b5b6225de036652542817789

entry.title: 0.71.2 — Security and privacy fixes with less battery use.
entry.summary:
Security and privacy fixes with less battery use.
3 faster · 4 fixed
## Faster
- iCloud sync no longer checks in every 5 seconds. It runs when something changes, when iCloud pushes a change, when you come back to Circa, and every 10 minutes as a safety net. At idle, forced disk flushes drop from about 2 every 5 seconds → 0 between two 10-minute safety checks, saving battery and disk writes. A change made on another Mac can take up to 10 minutes to arrive if its push notification is missed. - Swiping between Spaces with a textured theme repaints the paper grain 240 → 2 times over a 120-frame swipe, and tabs with a custom symbol icon no longer rebuild the sidebar on every update. - Deleting history entries no longer runs the icon cleanup when no visit is actually removed: about 198 ms → skipped on a 200,000-visit history.
## Fixed
- Clearing your history also removes the deleted pages from the iCloud sync journal and from the synced copies in iCloud. "All Time" and removing a profile also wipe the engine's own internal history files the next time Circa starts. - Icons from websites are checked more strictly before they are displayed, so a malicious page can no longer use an unusual image format to reach the system's image decoder. - Look-alike addresses in the command bar suggestions now show in their real form. An address that imitates another one with foreign letters (for example a Cyrillic "а" in place of a Latin "a") shows as `xn--…`. Normal international addresses such as `münchen.de` still display normally. - The app is signed with narrower system permissions: the main process now refuses to load code that is not signed by Circa, and only the engine processes that need it keep the exceptions.
## Known limits
- Deleting a time range or a single site does not yet clear the engine's internal history, only Circa's own. - After this update, the history database cannot be opened by older Circa versions.
